name: Almuñécar (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided sky blue over blue, charged at the centre with the arms of Almuñécar beneath a mural crown (a ship above waves on blue).
history: Both symbols were made official on 22 February 2021; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of two equal horizontal stripes, sky blue above and blue below, with the municipal arms at the centre of the cloth.

features.role: Almuñécar arms — ship above waves beneath a mural crown
